featured_reviews.review_text:
Madh Lighthouse, located on the picturesque Madh Island in Mumbai, is a hidden gem that beautifully combines history and natural beauty. This iconic lighthouse, built in 1867, stands as a testament to Mumbai’s maritime heritage and offers visitors a unique glimpse into the city’s past. The striking white structure against the backdrop of the azure Arabian Sea is a photographer’s delight, making it a popular spot for both tourists and locals alike.

The journey to the lighthouse is as enchanting as the destination itself. Visitors can enjoy a scenic boat ride from Versova beach, which adds an element of adventure to the trip. Upon arrival, the lush greenery surrounding the lighthouse invites exploration, and the serene beaches nearby provide a perfect place to relax and unwind.

Climbing to the top of the lighthouse offers breathtaking panoramic views of the coastline and the vast sea, making it an unforgettable experience. The gentle sea breeze and the sound of waves create a tranquil atmosphere, ideal for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of city life.

While Madh Lighthouse might not be as well-known as other attractions in Mumbai, its charm lies in its relative seclusion and historical significance. It’s a must-visit for anyone seeking a unique experience in Mumbai. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a photography lover, or simply someone looking to enjoy nature, Madh Lighthouse is well worth the visit.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you want a short escape from Mumbai’s endless traffic, crowded streets, and fast-paced routine, then Madh Island offers exactly that. Tucked away on the northern edge of the city, this coastal destination feels surprisingly detached from Mumbai despite being within city limits. The journey itself whether by road or via the ferry near Versova Beach adds to the charm and makes the place feel like a hidden getaway.

What stands out most about Madh Island is its peaceful atmosphere. Unlike Juhu or Girgaon Chowpatty, the beaches here are far less commercialized and considerably less crowded. Places such as Erangal Beach, Dana Pani Beach, and Madh Beach are perfect for long walks, watching sunsets, or simply sitting by the sea and enjoying the sound of the waves. The rustic fishing villages, coconut trees, old bungalows, and coastal roads give the area a unique charm that is becoming increasingly rare in Mumbai.

The island is not without its flaws. Several visitors mention that cleanliness can vary depending on the season and crowd levels, and some stretches of the beach may have litter or a slight smell associated with fishing activities. Road conditions and traffic during peak hours can also be frustrating, especially while leaving after sunset. However, most people agree that the tranquility, greenery, and open spaces more than compensate for these shortcomings.

Overall, Madh Island is one of Mumbai’s most underrated destinations. It is not a luxury beach town or a perfect tourist hotspot, but that is exactly what makes it special. If you are looking for a peaceful evening, a scenic drive, a weekend staycation, or simply a place to disconnect from the chaos of city life, Madh Island delivers a refreshing experience that feels worlds away from Mumbai while still being a part of it.

featured_reviews.name: Derishta Pillay
featured_reviews.review_text:
At the outset I must say that neither myself nor my husband are huge fans of the usual guided walking tours mainly because we hate being taken to cliched and crowded tourist hotspots, listening to facts straight from the Wikipedia page and jostling for space with other tourists just to return sunburned and underwhelmed. In addition we'd already spent a hectic 5 weeks in India - we were tired, grumpy, waiting to fly back home and not at all looking forward to our last 4 days in Mumbai at all. So basically when our travel companions insisted we book a tour - the scene was set for disaster...
'Bombay Walks' single handedly turned this around and Mumbai actually turned out to be the highlight of our trip! (Nope this is not a sponsored review 😂)

The tour: Arpan's tour extends to the days before and after the actual tour as he offers valuable advice about where to stay/eat/party/shop etc. He speaks perfect English, is pleasant and very easy to communicate with. His passion and love for the city is infectious and you will end his tour enthralled, overwhelmed and completely charmed by Mumbai and it's people - vowing to come back and dig deeper, spend longer and see more. The city tour covers many facets of the city - traveling to hidden gems and local landmarks across the length and breadth of Mumbai. You get to see and experience aspects of Mumbai that you'd never be able to do alone with a guide book or google maps - like traveling on local trains and walking through Worli fishing village and stopping by at small off-the-beaten path temples and churches.

The guide: Arpan is reliable, trustworthy and comes well prepared for the type of group. His talking style is light-hearted and easy going but still knowledgeable and always engaging. He's the type of guide that can tell you interesting facts about the history, architecture and politics of a place but also where to get the best coconut water along the way and which public toilets are ok to use.
We only met Arpan in person on the day of the tour and although we were constantly bombarded with sights, sounds and smells (it is Mumbai after all) - it never once felt like we were just being dragged from point to point whilst he rattled off information but rather that we were spending the day walking around with an old friend.

Target travelers: We're fairly well travelled and yet this is the first time we've ever bothered to leave a tour review - on any platform - I think that in itself indicates how highly we recommend this tour.
This is really a 'must do' in Mumbai.
It's so good we would do this tour again even if it were to cover the exact route we already took. The walking wasn't particular strenuous so it's recommended for any age group it should also be noted that we found that     Arpan was discreetly always conscious of where the group members were and their safety and constantly aware of our surroundings and the locals around us - on that note I would recommend this tour even if you're a single female traveling alone.

When to do it: Try and do this tour on your first full day in Mumbai because it's also a great way to orientate yourself around the city and plan the rest of your time there.

That city that everyone talks about - that's all of India's many faces and layers in one, that accepts everyone, that's everyone's home - regardless of language, religion or creed - Mumbai is THAT city and you'd be crazy if you miss the opportunity to let a born-and-bred local guide you around...

Shortcut
Forest Park in Powai is an escape from the pollution and the hustle of the city. Here’s why you should take some time off.

What Makes It Awesome
Amidst the sky scrapers at Hiranandani is a green patch that Powai residents look forward to. Forest Park is a non-manicured forest leftover that still retains that old world charm with gazebos and paths lined with rocks. They have a jogging track to run at and seating for you to rest at. Since the rain Gods have been more than gracious off late, we think it would be a treat to sit and admire the weather and smell the rain hitting the mud.

The park sits quietly at Hiranandani Gardens and is frequented by fitness enthusiasts, strollers and college students. It’s open from 6AM in the morning till 10AM and reopens again till 6 PM. The entry to the park is free.

Pro-Tip
If you need some respite from the heat, Forest Park is always a few degrees lesser that the usual temperature outside.

Harihar Fort was one of the best experiences of my life. The trek is scary at some points — especially the steep rock-cut steps — but that’s what makes it so thrilling and unforgettable. Our group was super strong, fast-moving, and always supportive of each other, which made the journey even better.
The guides were amazing. Both were highly experienced, very helpful, and knew every route perfectly. They explained everything clearly, shared all the important information, and guided us safely throughout the trek. Their confidence and knowledge made even the toughest sections feel manageable.
Overall, it was an adventurous, challenging, and extremely rewarding experience. If you love thrill, teamwork, and epic views, Harihar Fort is a must-do — especially with careful and experienced guides.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent trek to Sondai fort with Treks and Trails was truly awesome. The trek leaders—Sameer, Abhijeet, and co-lead Ankita—were very friendly, caring, and experts in their field. From the booking process to the very end of the trek including food and refreshments all the arrangements were absolutely 100%.
​My team had a great time,  even though 85% of the group were first-timers, everyone finished the trek strong! All credit goes to our trek leaders. Thank you, Treks and Trails!

featured_reviews.name: Cyon Dmello
featured_reviews.review_text:
I thoroughly enjoyed the trek experience, starting right from our jeep ride at Kasara station to the base point at Bari village and then onward to the summit expedition.

Our Trek Leader, Sir Soham guided us exceptionally well with his expertise sharing valuable insights about the place along with the important do’s and don’ts. His leadership truly enhanced the overall experience.

The food served at the local village house was another highlight—it was warm, authentic and gave me the comforting feeling of a home-cooked meal.

Overall, everything was well-organized from the trek lead to the group dynamics. I had a wonderful time and look forward to joining many more such treks in the future.

name: Green Valley Park
description:
Discover the beauty of nature at Green Valley Park, a nature preserve and animal park in CBD Belapur. With its many rare birds, lush flora and fauna, and unique native trees, this park is a haven for wildlife lovers. Enjoy a hike along one of the park's many trails, or simply relax and enjoy the peace and quiet listening to one of the many waterfalls and rivers. Green Valley Park is the perfect place to escape the hustle and bustle of city life.

There's also an outdoor gym at the top of the hike where people can casually exercise in the beauty of the jungle overlooking the mountainside and golden temple on the opposite mountain peak.

We at Champions Academy had the pleasure of collaborating with MH02 Events and Holidays for our year-end student trip to Amritsar, Dalhousie, and Dharamshala, and we couldn't be happier with the experience they delivered.

Right from the planning phase to the final drop-off, the entire team was exceptionally professional, dedicated, and detail-oriented. Special thanks to our tour operators, Mr. Sushant and Sundar Bhai, who went above and beyond to ensure that every one of our students was safe, comfortable, and most importantly—having fun. Their calm demeanor, problem-solving attitude, and friendly nature made the trip smooth and enjoyable for everyone involved.

The train meals provided were hygienic, fresh, and thoughtfully planned, with plenty of variety to suit all taste buds. The hotels arranged across all locations were clean, scenic, and comfortable, making our stay relaxing after long days of travel and exploration. Every sightseeing spot was well-managed, and we were given ample time to enjoy, click photos, and take in the experience without being rushed.

A big shoutout to Mr. Sumit Shetty, the owner of MH02 Events and Holidays, who was not just the mastermind behind the planning but stayed personally involved throughout the tour. He was in constant touch with us from Day 1, ensuring that every part of the journey went according to plan. His proactive communication and attention to detail gave us great confidence and peace of mind, especially while managing a group of over 80 students.

Thanks to MH02 Events and Holidays, our students returned with smiles, stories, and memories that they will cherish forever. The parents of our students have also expressed their appreciation for the safe, well-managed, and fun-filled experience their children had.

In my 5+ years of conducting student trips, this was truly one of the most well-executed and memorable tours—and much of the credit goes to the team at MH02 Events and Holidays.

Thank you once again for helping us create such a beautiful chapter in our students’ lives. We look forward to many more journeys together in the future! 🌍✨
